messages:
alice: quick q — planning to tweak the api-service k8s manifest. plan is to lower cpu requests 200m -> 100m, tighten limits to 500m, reduce liveness initialDelay 15 -> 5, and add minReadySeconds: 10. manifest is at infra/k8s/services/api/deployment.yaml in the infra repo. any red flags on rolling updates or risk of OOMs? pinging @ben for numbers.

ben: sounds reasonable but couple of checks: 1) confirm HPA target and current cpu usage (if HPA triggers on requests we could see more frequent scaleups). 2) keep limits >= 2-3x requests to avoid CPU throttling during bursts. 3) lowering liveness initialDelay to 5 is aggressive for cold starts; do we have metrics for startup time? otherwise keep ~10. also set rollingUpdate.strategy to avoid >1 pod down. sample snippet:```yaml
spec:
  strategy:
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 1
      maxSurge: 0
  minReadySeconds: 10
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: "100m"
          limits:
            cpu: "500m"
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
```

carla: i'll open the terraform PR with the patched manifest and run a canary deploy in staging first. will add a rollout pause step in the pipeline so we can watch metrics.

dylan: tiny ask — when you update the deployment please also include the secret checksum annotation for DB creds to force a controlled rollout when secrets rotate. we have infra/api/db-creds in k8s. pattern: `kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt` or `checksum/secret: {{ sha256 }}.`

ben: exact checksum pattern we use in infra: `checksum/secret-db-creds: {{ sha256sum }}` as an annotation on the pod template. CI will then trigger a new ReplicaSet when secret changes. also remember to update the HPA targetCPUUtilization if you change requests drastically.

carla: PR opened -> https://git.redwood.internal/infra/merge/219. title: "api: lower cpu requests, add minReadySeconds, liveness tweak". pipeline kicked off. tagging @alice @ben for review.

devops-bot: CI pipeline passed for PR #219 (lint, terraform plan, k8s manifest validation). plan shows 2 pods rolling with updated template; no tainted nodes.

alice: thanks — i'll watch staging metrics during the canary window and give :thumbsup: if stable. will call out if we need to revert.
